hardware: RTX 4090; simulation only; no new base-model download
input: subgoal start RGB + current RGB + subgoal instruction; 512px same camera per pair
done_definition: requested relation satisfied and target released; ambiguity leads to abstention, not credit for success
generation: Matched positive/offset/hover/edge variants share robot pose, camera and background. Counterfactuals are static simulator snapshots, not autonomous robot successes. Natural held/released examples supplement them.
grouping: All variants from a complete scene-instance group stay in one split; assets/tasks may be shared. No frame-level random split.
existing_long_checks: Initials0-2 are retained for deployment diagnostics only, never gradient or threshold selection.
observability: Narrow margins near geometric/contact boundaries are unknown training targets; record official predicate separately. Report abstention and missed true completions, not just false-positive rate.

offline_acceptance.decision_rule: validation-only threshold; unknown/rejection counts as missed completion on positives

closed_loop_acceptance.comparison: same frozen v3 plans, seeds, image resolution, action settings and budget; only checker changes; contemporaneous paired base if offline passes
closed_loop_acceptance.false_switches: manually aligned predicate subset; unsupported steps separately reported

deployment_scope: Transport end-state goals supported by generated data; articulated-state changes and standalone pickup retain the base checker. Scope frozen before model evaluation.
stop_rule: Complete offline train/test first. If offline criteria fail, do not launch full closed-loop batch; report failure and retain artifacts without unlimited tuning. If pass, run the paired closed-loop acceptance once and report all outcomes.

training.checkpoint_selection: highest validation completion recall with validation FPR<=5%, then lower FPR and 3-class macro recall; all chosen before test

premodel_clarification: Checkpoint selection aligned to the operational acceptance metric before any model scoring; data split and acceptance limits unchanged.

development_amendment.reason: Validation recall of JSON-sequence SFT was insufficient; use direct class-logit CE before opening test set. Acceptance limits and split unchanged.
development_amendment.warm_start: validation-selected JSON update360; no test scores used
